en: XcreenShot's clipboard: Win+Alt+V opens a panel with your recent captures; pick one or more and Insert pastes the original images into the app you were in.
es: Portapapeles de XcreenShot: Win+Alt+V abre un panel con tus capturas recientes; elige una o varias e Insertar pega las imágenes originales en la app en la que estabas.
